scope.explanation: Uses the prior proven audited-pallet rehearsal scope, excludes the large System pallet prefix, and adds Babe, Liveness, current custom-version guards and raw runtime markers. Full Staking contains all publication inputs, claim state and exposures needed by the runtime-local Liveness upgrade refresh. Full MultiBlockMigrations retains live cursor and historical migration state.

limitations: This records read-only preflight and the intended native rehearsal scope; it does not claim the native rehearsal has run or passed.

System.Account, native balance accounts, nonnative token balances, assets and unrelated pallets are omitted. This scoped snapshot validates configured upgrade hooks, audited storage versions and bridge replay/index bounds, not actual payout execution. The exact-Wasm live-state fork supplies separate payout evidence.
Child tries are omitted; the selected migration paths use ordinary pallet/raw storage. This is not a complete chain-state snapshot or a global state-invariant check.

The scope relies on the pinned preflight showing legacy guard versions current. If any guarded old migration becomes active at another checkpoint, expand that pallet and its dependencies before rehearsal.

Do not reuse a previously narrower snapshot simply because its block hash matches. remote.rs verifies the snapshot header but does not verify its original filter coverage. Use a new scoped snapshot or one known to be a superset.
Only eight EthBridge maps are scraped. They cover all explicit remote.rs audits and the current v4 migration no-op; unrelated bridge maps are not covered.
This is a native runtime execution rehearsal, not validator consensus, host-import completeness, signed transactions or governance enactment.
